en.name: Architect
en.ability: Each night*, choose a player: 1) they become a not-in-play character of the same type, or 2) they swap characters with a player of the same type.

revisions.v1: Each night*, choose a player: 1) they become a not-in-play character of the same type, or 2) they swap characters with a player of the same type.

en.flavor: "I found Rome a city of bricks and left it the city of marbles." - Caesar Augustus 'Octavian' 63 B.C. – 14 A.D.
en.otherNightReminder: The Architect points to a player. Choose which ability will effect the chosen player. Treat them accordingly (not-in-play character or character swap). Wake affected players individually. Show 'You are', then their new character token.

zh.name: 建筑师
zh.ability: 每个夜晚*，你要选择一名玩家：1）他变成一个与他角色类型相同的不在场角色，或者2）他与一名与他角色类型相同的玩家交换角色。

revisions.v1: 每个夜晚*，你要选择一名玩家：1）他变成一个与他角色类型相同的不在场角色，或者2）他与一名与他角色类型相同的玩家交换角色。

zh.flavor: ‘朕接手之罗马，砖城尔，朕留下之罗马，玉石城也。’-凯撒·奥古斯都 ‘屋大维’ 前63-14
zh.otherNightReminder: 唤醒建筑师，让他指向一名玩家。选择选项1或2。唤醒每名被选择的玩家并向他（他们）展示“你是”信息标记和他（他们）的新角色标记。
